SHOWHAUS Studio See the live demo ↗

A 3D walkthrough of your project, for your portfolio site and your emails.

Buyers see their future view and sunlight from sunrise to sunset, plus aircraft (ANEF) and road noise, for each floor/aspect — before the building exists.

Demo: Arncliffe Central (SSD-11429726) — massing model from public planning documents · sun position: NOAA · surrounding buildings: OpenStreetMap. Made independently; not endorsed by the developer or any agency.

Included in the pilot

  • Your project’s massing placed among the real surrounding buildings, floor by floor, from your approved plans or planning documents.
  • Direct-sun hours for every floor and facade — today, 21 June and 21 December — with the method stated (estimates, never called measured).
  • “View from level N”: what is in line of sight from each floor and aspect, computed from terrain and building data.
  • Aircraft-noise and road facts with their sources, plus the planning controls on the site.
  • A slow cinematic walkthrough that plays on load, a one-line embed for your portfolio website, and email assets: a looping GIF, an MP4, a poster and stills.
  • Scope stated in writing before work starts.

Not built yet — part of the pilot, in plain words

  • Photoreal exteriors and interiors. Today’s walkthrough is a massing model: real geometry, real sun, real outlook — not a render.
  • Our world engine. It has not generated a scene yet. Founding pilots are where it gets built; at delivery we tell you exactly what is ready and what is not.

We never use renders, images or brochures of a developer or architect without permission, and we never imply an endorsement we don’t have.
